Browser-only behavior documented and made native-safe per contract: the global window.addEventListener('keydown') handler with every case (Space, ArrowLeft/Right with Shift, comma/period frame-step, Home/End, digit 0-9 percent seek, J/K/L, +/=/-/_ speed, m/M no-op) L117-258, the transient ShortcutToast state/showShortcutToast timer and its cleanup L62-65/L105-115/L260-264/L335-343, and the route-scoped useShortcut cheatsheet registry replayShortcutDefs L299-326 all depend on a DOM-global hardware-key event source and the DOM lib, which core React Native (native tsconfig, no DOM lib) does not provide; they are intentionally not wired on native and their shortcut intent is surfaced through the help popover instead.
